title: Phase 5 B3-B5 evidence manifest row
description: One row per piece of claim-linked evidence used to score B3-B5. All evidence must share a real claim_id and satisfy event_time <= scored_at.

claim_id.description: Must exist in the claim/prediction set.

event_time.description: received_at for document/image, available_at for entity_edge.

scored_at.description: Claim decision time; identical for every row of the same claim; must be >= event_time.

source.description: Real claim provenance, not a standalone public dataset row.

$comment: Stage requirements: B3 needs >=1 document per scored claim; B4 needs B3 + >=1 image; B5 needs B4 + >=1 entity_edge. Do not join Kaggle/CarDD/SROIE rows as the same claim.
